_meta.purpose: Ground-truth reference set for validating the stem-loop RT-qPCR primer designer.
_meta.design_is_deterministic_note: For Chen-2005 stem-loop RT-qPCR, two of the three primers are fully determined by the mature miRNA sequence: (1) the RT stem-loop primer = fixed universal body + reverse-complement of the 3'-terminal 6 nt; (2) the universal reverse primer is a fixed constant. The forward primer's specific region equals the 5' prefix of the miRNA. The validator recomputes these expected values independently from the SAME sequence the tool used (returned in metadata.mirna_sequence), so results do not depend on any hand-entered sequence.
sources: [Chen05] Chen C et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2005;33(20):e179 — original stem-loop RT-qPCR; RT primer hybridizes 6-8 nt at 3' end of mature miRNA.

[Wang17] Wang Y et al. Mol Med Rep. 2017;17(3):3690-3696. DOI 10.3892/mmr.2017.8297 (PubMed PMID 29257343) — let-7 members share 16 identical 5' nt; single-nucleotide discrimination; amplification efficiency 0.93-1.14.
[Var07] Varkonyi-Gasic E et al. Plant Methods 2007;3:12 — protocol; 6-nt overhang optimal.
[MIQE09] Bustin SA et al. Clin Chem 2009;55(4):611-622. DOI 10.1373/clinchem.2008.112797 (PMID 19246619) — qPCR efficiency 90-110% acceptable.

_published_primer_exact_match.purpose: OPTIONAL exact-match layer vs a real published primer table. Absent by default — sequences are NEVER fabricated; add them only from a cited paper table.
_published_primer_exact_match.how_to_add: On any entry in `mirnas`, add one or more of: `published_rt` (full stem-loop RT primer), `published_rt_overhang` (3' 6-nt overhang only), `published_forward` (forward qPCR primer), `published_source` (citation). U/T and case are normalized before comparison.
checks_emitted: published_forward_contains_specific — published forward contains the tool's miRNA-specific region (tolerant of differing 5' tails)
_published_primer_exact_match.caveat: Exact forward-primer match only holds vs papers using the SAME universal stem-loop tail (Chen 2005 system). For different tails, rely on `published_forward_contains_specific`.

mirnas.published_source: Chen L, Bosmajian C, Woo S (2024). 'A highly sensitive stem-loop RT-qPCR method to study siRNA intracellular pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.' Biology Methods & Protocols 9(1):bpae029. DOI 10.1093/biomethods/bpae029 (PMID 38783988, PMC11112049, open access; confirmed on PubMed), Supplemental Table 2 — independent lab (University at Buffalo, SUNY), uses miR-16 as the endogenous normalizer for intracellular siRNA quantification. Uses the identical Chen-2005 44-nt universal stem-loop body AND the identical 20-nt universal reverse primer as this tool; the tool's RT primer and universal reverse are byte-identical to this published set (independently re-verified against the live tool's /api/design output). SECOND, independent source for the same miRNA: Nguyen Hoang Thao Vy et al. (2020), Hoi nghi Cong nghe Sinh hoc Toan quoc 2020 (Vietnam national biotech conference proceedings, not PubMed-indexed), pp. 181-186, Table 1 — reports the same stem-loop RT primer and the same forward-primer specific region; that source's own reverse-primer entry is 19 nt ('CCAGTGCAGGGCCGAGGTA', and its own length column inconsistently says '16 bp'), an apparent transcription anomaly in that table, not used for matching here. THIRD source: Chen C et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2005;33(20):e179, DOI 10.1093/nar/gni178 (PMID 16314309), supplementary 'TaqMan miRNA assays' — RT primer GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGACCGCCAA, byte-identical; forward CGCGCTAGCAGCACGTAAAT.

mirnas.role: length variation (miRBase v22: 24 nt) + forward-core concordance vs TWO independent published assays; also documents a 3'-end annotation change that affects the RT overhang
mirnas.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-155): RT GTTGGCTCTGGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACCAGAGCCAACACCCCT, forward GTGGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGAT. Also Yang L-h, et al. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293: forward GCGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGATA (same miRNA-specific core; different USLP body). Forward-core comparison only. NOTE — overhang NOT scored: both papers anchor the RT primer on the older 23-nt mature miR-155 (3' end ...AGGGGU; Czimmerer overhang ACCCCT; Yang 8-nt ACCCCTAT), whereas miRBase v22 / this tool's database annotate hsa-miR-155-5p as 24 nt (3' end ...GGGGUU), giving overhang AACCCC. This is a reference-annotation difference, not a design error — but it means a primer ordered from the 2013/2014 papers binds a 1-nt-shifted 3' end.

mirnas.role: liver-specific marker
cross-system forward-primer concordance vs a DIFFERENT universal stem-loop system (Yang 2014 USLP) — validates the miRNA-specific forward-primer principle across independent chemistries
mirnas.published_source: Yang L-h, et al. Universal Stem-Loop Primer Method. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293 — miR-150 forward qPCR primer (5' GC tail added to raise Tm). NOTE: Yang 2014 uses a different stem-loop body and reverse (random 3' end), so only the forward miRNA-specific core is comparable; no RT exact-match applies. Yang's miR-150 stem-loop 3' end is CACTGGTA (8 nt binding); this tool's 6-nt overhang CACTGG is its prefix — within Chen's 6-8 nt range, not scored.

mirnas.role: forward-core concordance + demonstrates the Chen 6-8 nt binding range. The published RT used a 7-nt overhang (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3' UAUUGGC... last 7 nt), whereas this tool uses a fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT). No 6-nt RT exact-match is asserted; only the forward-specific core is scored.
mirnas.published_source: Zhao F-L, Dou Y-C, Wang X-F, Han D-C, Lv Z-G, Ge S-L, Zhang Y-K. 'Serum microRNA-195 is down-regulated in breast cancer: a potential marker for the diagnosis of breast cancer.' Mol Biol Rep. 2014;41(9):5913-5922. DOI 10.1007/s11033-014-3466-1, Table 2 ('The sequences of miR-16 and miR-195 stem-loop RT and PCR primers'). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body (GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGAC) and universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. NOTE: the published RT hybridizes 7 nt (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UAUUGGC); this tool's fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT) is the 6-nt prefix of it — a deliberate design choice within Chen's 6-8 nt binding range, not a mismatch. Forward-specific core comparison only.

mirnas.role: forward-core concordance. Published forward (GGCGCC tail + ATAAAGCTAGATAAC) anchors the miRNA 5' prefix. Qualitative support for the short-duplex Tm caveat: the published table lists the 50-nt stem-loop primer Tm as 16 C, illustrating why a point Tm on the 6-nt binding duplex is not meaningful.
